summary: Iteration 10 retest of the v9 fixes. Backend: 15/15 new pytest cases pass (tests/test_silverpt_v10_fixes.py) and the v9 regression still passes 20/20. Covered: nutritionist dashboard finance is 0 and counts only the nutritionist's own packages (a temporary TEST package gives 120/yr -> 10/month); trainer finance unchanged; advice regex rejects '1 kg di pasta', '30% proteine', 'macro', ml, g and kcal and still accepts generic advice; daily_code matches the Europe/Rome day; PUT /me/public-key with key_backup and GET /me/key-backup. Frontend (390x844), 7/8 flows pass: ConsentGate shows for cliente@ (5 docs), trainer@ (terms/privacy/professional) and nutri@, and 'Seleziona tutti' + 'Accetto e continuo' unlocks the app. /feed shows flip-logo-nutrition. On Profile, tapping the coin keeps the photo side (flip-logo-back opacity 1). Plan item '80g avena': confirm with no known values opens the form (avena/80); edit opens the form and closing it keeps the item; saving hides it; the item stays hidden after reload; confirm with known values auto-logs 300 kcal (scaled from per100); remove persists after reload and the next day shows the item again. Finance tile and page both show 60€ (trainer) and 0€ (nutri). The district Select includes Avambracci and Adduttori. E2E key backup works ONLY when the chat is opened in the same JS session as the login. After a page reload (or app restart) the passphrase is lost: a new key pair is generated, the public key is overwritten without a backup, and the second browser could not decrypt (reproduced). Deprecated packages: none found.

minor.issue: When key_backup is omitted, public_key is updated but the old key_backup is kept, so the server can hold {pk_new, backup(sk_old)}. A new device then restores sk_old paired with pk_new (GET /me/key-backup returns the current public_key, not the one in the backup): a broken key pair that cannot decrypt anything. Verified by test_put_without_backup_keeps_old.

ui_bugs.issue: The leading-strip regex /^[\s\-di]+/ removes any leading 'd' or 'i' characters, not the word 'di'. Verified with node: '100g di insalata' -> 'nsalata', 'insalata 100g' -> 'nsalata', "100g d'orzo" -> "'orzo". Only '80g avena' works by luck. Use something like .replace(/^\s*(di\s+|d')/i, '').

find(meal includes 'colazione') returns only the first match, so the 'Seconda colazione' items (e.g. 'Latte 200ml' in Marco's plan) are never shown. 'items.split(/\n|;|,/)' also breaks decimals like '1,5 kg'.

integration_issues.issue: The passphrase is only in memory (setPassphrase at login). Reproduced: login -> page reload -> open chat with no local key -> myKeys creates a NEW key pair and PUTs public_key with no backup (DB had key_backup=None, pk overwritten). The second browser then got a different pk and could not decrypt the message. In-app navigation login -> hub-chat-button works: same pk restored and message decrypted in the 2nd context. On native, an app restart with a persisted token has the same problem. Old messages become unreadable whenever this happens.

The dismiss state is stored per device (AsyncStorage). In a fresh browser, '80g avena' showed again even though it was already logged that day, and confirming it created a duplicate meal (observed). Derive the hidden state from meals already logged for that date/meal (name match) as well as AsyncStorage.

issues: 'Accetto e continuo' is aria-disabled until all docs are ticked, but it looks almost as bright as the enabled red button. Make the disabled state clearly visible.

Only (tabs)/_layout is wrapped, so stack routes (/chat/*, /nutrition-plan/*, /plan-edit, /finance) opened by deep link or reload skip the gate. Also, while /legal/docs loads (or if it fails) the children are rendered, so the gate can be bypassed.
The header coin shows the Training logo on the nutritionist's Finance page (not in NUTRI_ROUTES). Consider using the Nutrition logo for every nutritionist page.

action_items: HIGH: Make E2E key restore survive reloads and restarts. Options: (a) at login, store the derived wrap key (not the password) in SecureStore/AsyncStorage next to the token; (b) when there is no local key and no passphrase, ask for the password instead of silently generating a new pair; (c) never overwrite public_key without a matching key_backup. Store pk inside the backup, or derive it with nacl.box.keyPair.fromSecretKey(sk), so a mismatched pair can't be restored.

Security note: the wrap key is SHA-512(email:password), and the server receives the plaintext password at login, so it can derive the wrap key and decrypt key_backup. Use a slow KDF with a salt, or a separate chat PIN, if true E2E against the server matters.
Fix parseItem's leading-'di' regex in src/nutrition.tsx:132 ('100g di insalata' -> 'nsalata').
Hide plan items that already match a meal logged that day, to avoid duplicates across devices.
Support multiple meal_plan entries matching a meal (Seconda colazione), and don't split on ',' inside decimals.
ConsentGate: also gate stack routes (wrap the root layout), and don't render children while /legal/docs is loading or has failed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py PUT /me/public-key: updating public_key without key_backup leaves a stale backup (see backend minor).
e2e.ts myKeys: the 'fresh' variable is unused (void fresh). If unwrap fails (e.g. after a password change), a new key is generated silently and history is lost without warning.
consent-gate.tsx: version comparison is fine; failed POSTs show ErrorText. OK.
flip-logo.tsx: works on /profile because the header remounts per screen. If headers ever persist across tabs, rot won't update when the path changes. Consider a useEffect on onProfile.
extra.py dashboard: the nutritionist scoping is correct. Trainer own_pkgs=None counts every subscription of its clients, including ones on a nutritionist-owned package, if that case ever exists.

rca_of_issue: E2E backup failure: setPassphrase() keeps the passphrase in a module variable only. A web reload or app restart clears it while the auth token survives. myKeys() then finds no local key and no passphrase, skips the restore, generates a new nacl pair and PUTs public_key without key_backup (Mongo: key_backup None, pk replaced). Repro: in a fresh browser, log in as cliente@ -> page.goto('/chat/<MARCO>') -> send a message -> in a 2nd fresh browser, log in and open the chat -> different pk, message not decrypted. Mitigation: persist the derived wrap key securely at login, or ask for the password when a restore is needed, and never publish a pk that has no matching backup.
